# ATELIER ATLAS (placeholder — replace with client-approved copy before launch)

> Handmade Moroccan furniture workshop in Marrakech.

## Collection
- Seating: travertine and solid-wood stools, benches, chairs (made to order).
- Tables & consoles: travertine tops with wood or hammered-metal bases.
- Lighting, mirrors, decor: same workshop finishes as furniture.

## Custom orders
- Sur-mesure: dimensions, stone, wood, and metal finishes specified by the buyer.
- Process: brief → design sketch → material/price confirmation → production → shipping.

## Contact
- Showroom visits in Marrakech by appointment.
